## Additional Features - **Building Collision** — A buildings index is included for all non-filtered buildings, assigning each a flat foundation depth of **−10 m** in-game. This provides underground collision geometry so that tunnels interact correctly with building footprints. Buildings are sourced from NLSC LoD1 (內政部國土測繪中心 3D 精緻建物模型), which carries surveyed per-building height and floor count for the entire island. - **Water Depth Index** — A water depth index restricts track placement in inland water bodies (rivers, lakes, reservoirs) using a flat **−4 m** index that prevents surface-level track placement. _Coastal bathymetry (Taiwan Strait + Pacific) is scheduled for a future v2 update once an offshore depth source is registered._ - **Neighborhood Labels** — Three layers of place name labels are embedded in the map: - _City labels_ — Special municipalities (直轄市) and provincial cities (省轄市) at the metropolitan scale (e.g. 臺北市 / Taipei). - _District labels_ — Names of all districts and townships (區 / 鄉 / 鎮 / 縣轄市) within the map boundary. - _Neighborhood labels_ — Village-level names (里) from the MOI 村里界圖 (Village & Borough Boundary) dataset published by the National Land Surveying and Mapping Center. ## Methodology This map is generated through a six-phase pipeline that transforms Taiwanese government census and employment statistics into georeferenced origin/destination demand points. **Point Seeding:** Candidate points are placed within each _里_ (village/borough) using population-weighted centroids derived from the NLSC 國土利用調查 (National Land Use Inventory) Level-2 raster (~10 m grid) combined with a 100 m residential-mesh density signal — a Non-Negative Least-Squares (NNLS) calibration against DGBAS 2020 Population & Housing Census employed-resident counts disaggregates the raster floor area into per-村里 candidate weights. **Mesh Reconciliation:** Initial point populations are refined by solving a constrained convex optimization that approximates each point's mass to residential and economic mesh ideals while preserving DGBAS 2020 Population & Housing Census (主計總處人口及住宅普查) per-village workplace × residence ground truth. **Aggregation:** A per-county Option A scaling factor reconciles the universe mismatch between the 2021 工商業普查 (Industry & Services Census) workplace persons-engaged count and the 2020 Population & Housing Census all-employed universe (including agriculture + public-sector). Agriculture employment is dropped at the township grain using the DGBAS census employment-status breakdown to avoid placing rural-residence farmers in workplace buildings. **Commute Assignment:** Commute flows are assigned using a gravity model with distance-decay, calibrated against per-county and per-township workplace × residence O/D matrices published by DGBAS for the 2020 census. A cordon-snap pass injects out-of-bundle commute mass from neighbouring counties as anchored sinks at TW county centroids; a Generalized IPF (GIPF) pass then pins each township's self-loop share to the per-township census ground truth. **Special Demand Injection:** Non-commuter demand generators are injected as an additive layer. Airport demand from CAA (民航局 / Civil Aeronautics Administration) 2024 throughput statistics; university demand from MOE (教育部 / Ministry of Education) per-school enrollment data restricted to the daytime (日間) cohort and the latest 學年度 (academic year); tourism demand from the Tourism Administration (交通部觀光署) annual visitor counts at major scenic-area facilities, filtered to facility-anchored counting methods (門票數 / 人工計數器 / 柵欄式計數設備 / AI 精密人流偵測 / 電子計數器) — entries measured via 電信數據 (telco district pass-through), 廟方估計 (temple self-report), 停車數概估 (parking estimation), or 自動車流監視 (traffic monitoring) are auto-skipped per the [Tourism Administration 主要觀光遊憩據點統計作業要點](https://stat.taiwan.net.tw/) methodology spec. Future expansion will add hospital (NHI), military (MND garrison roster), and cultural/sport venues as Phase E data lands. **Layout Reconciliation:** A final spatial pass resolves point overlaps and ensures map clickability while keeping special-demand locations fixed. ## Data Sources All demand modeling is derived from freely available Taiwanese government statistical datasets and public geospatial resources. ### Census & Demographics - **2020 Population & Housing Census** (主計總處人口及住宅普查 — per-township employment status by industry, per-county industry breakdown, per-village workplace × residence cross-tabulation) — [DGBAS](https://www.stat.gov.tw/) - **2020 Census Commute O/D** (per-county and per-township workplace × residence O/D matrices) — [DGBAS](https://www.stat.gov.tw/) - **2021 Industry & Services Census** (110年工商業普查 — per-township workplace persons-engaged with industry classification and officer/worker split) — [DGBAS](https://www.stat.gov.tw/) - **Monthly Village Population** (內政部戶政司村里人口統計 — per-里 household-register stock) — [MOI Department of Household Registration](https://www.ris.gov.tw/) ### Geospatial Reference - **National Land Use Inventory** (內政部國土利用調查 NLUI — Level-2 land-use classification raster, ~10 m grid) — [MOI NLSC](https://maps.nlsc.gov.tw/) -
